headline: Sales and margins accelerate to close a strong fiscal year
summary_short: Darden's fiscal fourth-quarter sales rose 13.7% y/y to $3.72 billion, with diluted EPS from continuing operations of $3.54 (+36.7% y/y) and adjusted diluted EPS of $3.66 (+22.8% y/y).
summary_long: Darden's fiscal 2026 fourth quarter (year ended May 31, 2026, including a 53rd operating week) posted sales of $3.72B, +13.7% y/y, on a 4.6% blended same-restaurant sales gain, 43 net new restaurants, and the extra week. Diluted EPS from continuing operations was $3.54 (+36.7% y/y); adjusted diluted EPS, excluding restaurant-closure/impairment and Chuy's-integration costs, was $3.66 (+22.8% y/y). Net income rose 33.3% y/y to $404.9M. The company repurchased $138M of stock in the quarter, authorized a new $1.5B buyback, and raised its quarterly dividend 8.0% to $1.62/share. Cash fell to $219.5M (-8.5% y/y) as long-term debt declined 23.1% to $1.638B. Darden issued fiscal 2027 guidance: sales of $13.60-$13.75B and diluted EPS of $11.10-$11.35.

drivers.explanation: Growth reflects an extra (53rd) operating week (+7.6 pts of the +13.7% total), a 4.6% blended same-restaurant sales increase, and 43 net new restaurants.
The extra week alone added $0.25 to both reported and adjusted diluted EPS; management attributes the rest of the gain to same-restaurant sales growth across brands.
Net income growth (+33.3%) outpaced revenue growth (+13.7%); EBIT margin expanded to ~13.9% from ~11.8% a year earlier, a swing the release does not further decompose.
Cash fell and long-term debt declined as the company funded $138M of quarterly buybacks, a new $1.5B repurchase authorization, and an 8.0% dividend increase to $1.62/share.

Darden initiated fiscal 2027 guidance (sales $13.60-$13.75B, same-restaurant sales +2.5% to +3.5%, diluted EPS $11.10-$11.35), citing continued brand execution; this is a fresh full-year outlook, not a revision of a prior range.
